subject: hashtable: scan no-duplicate guarantee and add HasPassedKey API (#3803)
reason: The diff adds only (1) documentation comments describing already-existing scan guarantees, (2) a new API function hashtableScanHasPassedKey that is declared in hashtable.h and defined in hashtable.c but never called from any server code path — grep shows its only callers are the new unit tests in test_hashtable.cpp, and (3) those unit tests themselves. hashtableScan's actual logic is unchanged, so no command reply, SCAN behavior, replication, persistence, or any other server behavior differs between the parent and the change. There is no reachable behavior change for a fuzzer scenario to exerc
